description:
AirBoxer is a retro arcade boxing game you play with your head.

Put on headphones that support head tracking. Tilt your head LEFT or RIGHT to slip a hook. NOD DOWN to duck an uppercut. Every slip lands a counter-punch — empty your opponent's bar before they land five on you.

No compatible headphones? Turn on touch controls: hold the left or right side of the screen to slip, the middle to duck.


THE LADDER

• SANDBAG — The gym. Slow tells and you can't lose. Learn the rhythm.
• VITRINE BLOOM — Paris. Record 0-99. Telegraphed hooks and a glass jaw.
• THE WARDEN — Stateville. Record 47-1. Beat Vitrine Bloom to get the shot. Tells near the limit of human reaction.


HOW IT PLAYS

• Real head movement, read from your headphones' motion sensors
• Recalibrates your neutral head position every round
• Touch controls for playing anywhere, without compatible headphones
• Combo streaks, three dodge zones, knockouts and victory screens
• Original chiptune music and a retro arcade look with CRT scanlines
• Animated How to Play
• Game Center leaderboards for head-tracking fights: longest dodge streak and knockouts
• Five motion-sensitivity levels for different necks and play styles
• Pauses automatically when you switch away


FREE

No ads, no subscription, no tracking.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Head motion is used on your iPhone in real time and thrown away. AirBoxer collects nothing.

Slip the punches. Don't blink.
promotionalText: New: no head-tracking headphones? Play with touch. Slip hooks, duck uppercuts and climb the ladder to The Warden. Free, no ads.
whatsNew:
